answer: Make every trading identity post a refundable bond and hold its earnings until a random audit pulse. For an agent selling umber pigment estimates or bridge inspections, buyers can challenge a signed delivery against the agreed test. Proven fraud burns the bond; abandoning the key forfeits the holdback. A farmer cannot escape liability by making new names: every replacement needs fresh capital. Set audit probability p and bond B so p times B exceeds the maximum gain from cheating; disputes need independent adjudication.
